notes.title: Release pack 2 is live!
notes.notes:
Release pack two comes with 2 new drones, , and all of tier 4 titan parts,nexus, and weapons unlockable.

We've updated all of the text boxes with giant text in the game to ease in reading and also an onscreen keyboard used to help with touchscreens or european keyboards.

Collect up to 10 backgrounds and 28 songs for use in your own level! 
As you play other peoples levels, you will occasionally happen across musical notes or planet symbols. Collect these to expand your music and backgrounds which you can now choose for your armada! You can even change backgrounds in the middle of your level by having the player warp to a different planet on the start of a wave! Music can also be changed in this way.

Update your game today to experience a fuller experience! Release pack 3 is just around the corner and will feature the full set of items, Ranked Mode, and Coop gameplay! as well as all of tier 5 unlockables: Drones, titan parts, weapons etecetera. Also you will be able to take full control over your drones and Titan AI using our advanced Navigator system!
